evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Relational attention (RA) disentangled from self-attention greatly increases data efficiency and out-of-training-sample generalization on purely relational tasks, but language modeling requires object-level and relational information to be integrated as well as disentangled, and RA-based LMs have remained largely unexplored.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: On the strict (100M-word) track, our best model ranks 6th of 55 overall and 3rd of 55 on the leaderboard's NLP-task subset at the time of writing; our two strongest models outperform the GPT-2 baseline on most benchmarks, with one attaining the highest EWoK score among strict-track entries.
